start: Workout open, Bench Press set 2 just ticked, rest of 2:00 counting under the exercise

steps.action: Tap the rest clock ('Tap to show Bench in use')
user_sees: Full screen: 'BENCH' over 'IN USE', 'Bench Press', 'Previous 60 kg × 8' in grey, 'Next 62.5 kg × 8', 'Resting · back in' with the big clock counting, the MettleUp logo
In the foot: the button 'I'm back' and the tick 'Show after every set of this exercise'
must_not: The rest clock stopping or starting again

steps.action: Walk away and come back while the clock counts
user_sees: The clock keeps counting; the screen stays on
must_not: The screen closing by itself before the rest ends

user_sees: The workout screen with the rest timer still counting

start: Same workout, Bench Press, IN USE screen open

steps.action: Tick 'Show after every set of this exercise'
user_sees: The tick shows; under the rest clock the line later reads 'In use opens after each set'
must_not: The screen closing on the tick

user_sees: IN USE opens by itself as the rest starts; a record pop-up for the set, if any, shows on top
must_not: IN USE hiding the record pop-up

steps.action: In Settings, Workouts, switch 'Show after every set' and start a new workout
user_sees: Exercises follow the switch and their own remembered tick
must_not: A tick for one exercise changing another exercise

start: IN USE screen open, the member away from the phone

steps.action: Someone else taps the screen, the sign or the strip round the tick
must_not: The sign closing on a stranger's tap

steps.action: The member presses the phone's Back
Open IN USE for an exercise with no known kit
user_sees: Plain 'IN USE' with no kit line
must_not: An empty line above IN USE

start: Bench Press with 'Show after every set' ticked

steps.action: Let the rest reach zero with IN USE open
user_sees: The sign closes by itself at the end of the rest
must_not: The sign staying up after the rest

steps.action: Open it again on the next rest and untick the box
user_sees: The next rest does not open it; the line under the clock reads 'Tap to show Bench in use' or 'Tap to show In use'
must_not: The line under the clock vanishing

steps.action: With Settings' 'Show after every set' off, tick the box for this exercise
user_sees: Settings' switch turns on too, so the tick works
must_not: A ticked box that does nothing

start: IN USE screen open on a bench, people nearby reading it

steps.action: Others look at the phone from a few metres
user_sees: Only the kit, 'IN USE', the lift name, the previous and next weight and reps, the rest clock and the MettleUp logo
must_not: The member's name, photo, phone number, body weight or gym details on the sign

user_sees: The workout screen, only for the member
must_not: The workout screen opened by a stranger's tap on the sign
